items.name: Aluminium Can
items.description: Lightweight metal containers used for drinks or other products.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center
guidance.preparation: Rinse cans before recycling. Crush to save space.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Aluminium Foil
items.description: Thin metal sheet used for wrapping food or lining cooking trays.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center
guidance.preparation: Clean and flatten foil before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Animal Bones
items.description: Hard skeletal remains from animals, often discarded after meals or processing. They can be used for making broth or ground into bone meal for fertilizer

guidance.disposal: Compost, or dispose of in organic waste if allowed.
guidance.preparation: Compost or dispose of in organic waste bins. If in large quantities, dispose of properly to avoid attracting pests.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Animal Waste
items.description: Waste produced by animals, including pet feces and livestock manure.

guidance.disposal: Compost for livestock waste or regular trash for pet waste
guidance.preparation: Wear gloves when handling. Do not dispose of in waterways.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Ash
items.description: Powdery residue left after burning organic materials like wood or coal.

guidance.disposal: Landfill or compost in small quantities
guidance.preparation: Ensure ash is cool before disposal. Avoid inhaling dust.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Barrels/Drums
items.description: Large cylindrical containers used for storage or transport of liquids and other materials.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or hazardous waste site
guidance.preparation: Ensure barrels are empty and clean before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Batteries
items.description: Devices that store chemical energy for electrical use.

guidance.disposal: Battery recycling facility or hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Wear gloves to avoid exposure to battery acid. Do not dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Bedding and Blankets
items.description: Household textiles used for covering and cushioning beds.

guidance.disposal: Textile recycling program or donation
guidance.preparation: Ensure items are clean before donating.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Beverage Cartons
items.description: Cardboard containers used for storing liquids like milk or juice.

guidance.disposal: Recycling bin (if accepted locally)
guidance.preparation: Rinse before recycling. Remove plastic caps.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Bicycles
items.description: Two-wheeled vehicles powered by pedals.

guidance.disposal: Metal recycling facility or donation
guidance.preparation: Remove tires and accessories before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Books
items.description: Bound printed materials used for reading or study.

guidance.disposal: Paper recycling or donation
guidance.preparation: Remove plastic covers and any metal bindings.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Bottles
items.description: Containers made of plastic, commonly used for water, soda, or other beverages.

guidance.disposal: Plastic recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Rinse bottles before recycling. Remove caps if required by local recycling guidelines.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Brake fluid
items.description: Liquid used in hydraulic brake systems to transfer force.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Store in a sealed container. Do not mix with other fluids.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Building Materials / Bricks
items.description: Construction materials used in building structures.

guidance.disposal: Construction waste facility or reuse
guidance.preparation: Avoid inhaling dust. Ensure proper transportation to a disposal site.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Canned food
items.description: Food sealed in metal cans for long-term storage.

guidance.disposal: Metal recycling bin (for cans), food in compost (if applicable)
guidance.preparation: Rinse cans before recycling. Check if food inside is compostable.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Carpets
items.description: Textile floor coverings typically made of woven fabric.

guidance.disposal: Textile recycling or landfill
guidance.preparation: Remove adhesives or tacks before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cassava Peels
items.description: Outer skin removed from cassava roots during processing, often considered waste but can be used as animal feed or composted.

guidance.disposal: Compost or dispose of with organic waste.
guidance.preparation: Compost or use as animal feed. Avoid improper disposal, which could attract pests.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cassette Tapes
items.description: Magnetic tapes used to record and play music or audio.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center or landfill
guidance.preparation: Remove any metallic components before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: CDs
items.description: Optical discs used for storing music, videos, or data.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling or specialized recycling programs
guidance.preparation: Avoid breaking the disc, as it can cause sharp shards.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cereal Boxes
items.description: Cardboard packaging for storing cereal or other dry goods.

guidance.disposal: Recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Remove any plastic liners or packaging.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cigarette
items.description: A small roll of finely cut tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking. It produces non-biodegradable waste, including the filter and ash.

guidance.disposal: Extinguish fully, and dispose of in regular trash. Filters are not biodegradable.
guidance.preparation: Ensure fully extinguished before disposal. Do not litter; place in a bin to prevent fire and environmental harm.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cleaning Products
items.description: Substances used for cleaning or other chemical processes.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Store in original containers with labels intact. Do not mix different chemicals.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Clothes
items.description: Fabric-based garments worn for protection or fashion.

guidance.disposal: Textile recycling, donation, or regular trash if unusable
guidance.preparation: Ensure clothes are clean before donating or recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cooking Oil
items.description: A liquid fat used for frying, baking, or cooking. After use, it can be recycled into biodiesel or properly disposed of to prevent clogging drains.

guidance.disposal: Do not pour down drains. Collect in a container and take to a recycling center or dispose of it with solid waste if small quantities.
guidance.preparation: Allow it to cool before disposal. Never pour down the drain as it can cause blockages. Use a sealed container for disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cooking Oil Containers
items.description: Bottles or cans that store cooking oil, typically made of plastic or metal. They are recyclable when emptied and cleaned.

guidance.disposal: Clean and recycle plastic or metal containers where accepted.
guidance.preparation: Clean before recycling. Plastic or metal containers should go into respective recycling streams.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cotton Buds
items.description: Small sticks with cotton tips used for cleaning ears or cosmetic purposes. They are often single-use and may contribute to plastic waste unless made from biodegradable materials.

guidance.disposal: If made of plastic, throw in the trash. Biodegradable ones can be composted.
guidance.preparation: Avoid flushing down the toilet as they can block drains and pollute water systems. Dispose of in regular waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Computer Monitors
items.description: Display devices used with computers or video equipment.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid exposure to hazardous materials.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Dead Animals
items.description: The remains of dead animals, including pets or wildlife.

guidance.disposal: Contact animal control or veterinary services for proper disposal
guidance.preparation: Wear gloves and handle with care to avoid disease transmission.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Dental Floss
items.description: A thin, flexible string used to clean between teeth. Usually made of nylon or Teflon, it’s generally not recyclable and is discarded after use.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable, throw in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Do not flush. Dispose of in regular waste as it can clog drains and harm wildlife if littered.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Diapers
items.description: Absorbent garments used for babies and incontinent adults, made from plastic, paper, and absorbent gels. They are single-use items.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable, dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Wrap in a plastic bag before disposal to prevent odors. Dispose of in regular waste, as they are non-recyclable.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: DVD
items.description: Optical disc used for storing digital video, audio, or data.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling or specialized recycling programs
guidance.preparation: Avoid breaking the disc to prevent sharp shards.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Egg Cartons
items.description: Packaging material made from cardboard or plastic to protect eggs during transportation. Cardboard versions are recyclable or compostable, while plastic ones can be recycled.

guidance.disposal: Recycle cardboard cartons in paper recycling. Plastic cartons can go in plastic recycling.
guidance.preparation: Recycle if clean, or compost if made from cardboard. Clean plastic cartons before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Electronic Cables
items.description: Wires used to connect electronic devices to power sources or other devices. Often made from copper, aluminum, and plastic, they are recyclable through e-waste programs.

guidance.disposal: Recycle through electronic waste (e-waste) collection programs.
guidance.preparation: Recycle at e-waste facilities. Avoid cutting or burning, as they contain toxic materials.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Engine Oil
items.description: A lubricant used in vehicle engines to reduce wear on moving parts. It needs to be disposed of properly due to its hazardous nature, but it can be recycled and re-refined.

guidance.disposal: Dispose of at a hazardous waste facility or return to an auto service center for recycling.
guidance.preparation: Never pour on the ground or down the drain. Store in a sealed container and take to a hazardous waste facility.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Envelopes
items.description: Paper-based packaging used for sending letters or documents.

guidance.disposal: Paper recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Remove plastic windows before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Exercise Equipment
items.description: Machines and tools used for physical exercise, often made of metal and plastic.

guidance.disposal: Metal recycling center or donation
guidance.preparation: Disassemble bulky equipment for easier transport.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Fax Machines
items.description: Devices used to send documents via telephone networks.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove ink cartridges before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Fertilizers
items.description: Substances added to soil to promote plant growth, often containing nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium.

guidance.disposal: Use as directed or dispose of at hazardous waste collection sites
guidance.preparation: Store in a cool, dry place. Do not overapply to avoid runoff.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Fire Extinguishers
items.description: Devices used to control small fires, containing chemicals like CO or foam.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Do not puncture or incinerate. Ensure the extinguisher is empty before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Foil
items.description: Thin metal sheets often used for wrapping food or lining surfaces.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center
guidance.preparation: Clean and flatten foil before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Food Container
items.description: Plastic containers used to store food, often reusable.

guidance.disposal: Plastic recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Rinse containers before recycling. Remove any labels or stickers.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Fruit Peels
items.description: The outer skin of fruits like oranges, bananas, or mangoes, typically discarded after consumption but compostable and useful in gardens or animal feed.

guidance.disposal: Compost or dispose of with organic waste.
guidance.preparation: Compost organic waste where possible. Avoid throwing in the street as they attract pests.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Furniture
items.description: Household or office items used for seating, storage, or decoration.

guidance.disposal: Donate, reuse, or dispose of at large-item waste facilities
guidance.preparation: Disassemble large items for easier transport. Ensure items are clean if donating.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Gas Cylinders
items.description: Pressurized containers used for storing gases like propane or butane.

guidance.disposal: Return to supplier or hazardous waste facility
guidance.preparation: Do not puncture or incinerate. Ensure cylinders are empty before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Gas Stoves
items.description: Appliances that use gas (like propane or butane) to cook food. They can be recycled when dismantled into metal and plastic components.

guidance.disposal: Recycle as scrap metal or dispose of at e-waste facilities.
guidance.preparation: Ensure fully disconnected from gas before disposal. Recycle at scrap metal facilities.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Glue
items.description: Sticky substance used for bonding materials together, typically in tubes or bottles.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash (small quantities) or hazardous waste collection
guidance.preparation: Allow glue to harden before disposal. Do not pour liquid glue down drains.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Hair Weaves
items.description: Extensions made from synthetic or real human hair, used to enhance or change a person’s hairstyle. After use, they are often discarded and contribute to landfill waste.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable, dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Dispose of in regular trash. Do not flush or burn as they can block drains or release harmful fumes.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Ink Cartridges
items.description: Replaceable containers of ink used in printers.

guidance.disposal: Recycling programs or return to manufacturer
guidance.preparation: Avoid leaking ink. Handle with gloves if necessary.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Insecticide
items.description: Chemical substances used to kill insects or other pests.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Do not dispose of in regular trash. Wear gloves and follow safety instructions.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Inhalers
items.description: Medical devices used to deliver medication to the lungs, commonly for asthma or COPD. They are made from plastic and metal, and some parts can be recycled.

guidance.disposal: Return to pharmacies with recycling programs or dispose of in hazardous waste.
guidance.preparation: Do not throw in regular trash if they still contain medicine. Return to pharmacies or dispose of as hazardous waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Iron Sheets
items.description: Corrugated or flat sheets of iron used primarily for roofing or construction. They are durable and can be recycled as scrap metal after use.

guidance.disposal: Recycle as scrap metal.
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid injury. Recycle at scrap metal facilities.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Jewelry
items.description: Items made from precious metals or stones, worn for adornment.

guidance.disposal: Donate, sell, or recycle (depending on the material)
guidance.preparation: Handle with care, especially for valuable items.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Jute Bags
items.description: Reusable bags made from natural jute fibers, often used for carrying groceries or goods. They are biodegradable and environmentally friendly.

guidance.disposal: Compost or recycle through textile recycling programs.
guidance.preparation: Compost if natural fiber. Avoid mixing with non-biodegradable waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Kettles
items.description: Small kitchen appliances used for boiling water.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove any detachable parts (like cords) before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Keys
items.description: Metal tools used to unlock doors or secure locks. Typically made from brass or steel.

guidance.disposal: Recycle as scrap metal at metal recycling facilities.
guidance.preparation: Ensure they are placed in a metal recycling bin. Do not mix with regular waste as they can be recycled.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Kitchen Scraps
items.description: Organic waste from food preparation, like vegetable peels or leftover food.

guidance.disposal: Compost organic materials or throw them in organic waste bins.
guidance.preparation: Compost where possible. Do not mix with non-compostable waste to prevent contamination.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Kitchen Utensils
items.description: Tools like spoons, spatulas, or knives used in cooking. Typically made from metal, wood or plastic.

guidance.disposal: Recycle metal utensils. Plastic ones should be disposed of in regular trash unless recyclable.
guidance.preparation: Separate by material (metal, plastic) for proper recycling. Clean before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Knives
items.description: Sharp tools used for cutting, often made of metal.

guidance.disposal: Metal recycling or regular trash (if securely wrapped)
guidance.preparation: Wrap blades securely to prevent injury before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Light Bulbs
items.description: Devices that produce light by converting electricity, commonly made from glass and metal. Most common types are CFLs or LEDs,

guidance.disposal: Dispose at a hazardous waste facility or recycle through special programs, especially for CFLs and LEDs.
guidance.preparation: Handle carefully to avoid breakage. Some bulbs (CFLs) contain mercury, so dispose of at hazardous waste centers.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Lighters
items.description: Small portable devices used to ignite flames, often for smoking or starting fires. They are typically made of plastic and meta

guidance.disposal: Empty them completely before disposing of them in the trash. If refillable, they can be reused or taken to hazardous waste centers.
guidance.preparation: Ensure they are completely empty of gas. Do not dispose of them in a fire-prone area. Dispose of at hazardous waste facilities if they contain fuel.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Magazines
items.description: Printed publications containing articles, photos, and advertisements.

guidance.disposal: Paper recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Remove plastic covers or inserts before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Mattresses
items.description: Large soft items used for sleeping, often filled with foam or springs.

guidance.disposal: Bulky item waste collection or recycling center
guidance.preparation: Check local guidelines for mattress recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Makeup Containers
items.description: Small plastic or glass containers used to store cosmetics like foundation, lipstick, or powders.

guidance.disposal: Clean and recycle plastic/glass containers where facilities accept them. Otherwise, throw in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Clean before recycling to avoid contamination. Some containers might not be recyclable, so check local guidelines.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Mirrors
items.description: Glass surfaces coated with a reflective material, often used for personal grooming or decoration.

guidance.disposal: Do not recycle as regular glass. Dispose of them in the regular trash after safely wrapping to prevent injury.
guidance.preparation: Wrap in newspaper or cardboard to prevent injury and handle with care to avoid breaking glass.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Medicines
items.description: Substances used for medical treatment, often in the form of pills, liquids, or creams.

guidance.disposal: Pharmacy take-back programs or hazardous waste collection
guidance.preparation: Do not flush down the toilet. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Mobile Phones
items.description: Handheld electronic devices used for communication and other tasks.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling or trade-in programs
guidance.preparation: Wipe data before disposal. Remove battery if possible.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Napkins
items.description: Soft paper products used for wiping hands or faces during meals.

guidance.disposal: Compost (if clean) or regular trash
guidance.preparation: Avoid composting if contaminated with grease or food waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Newspapers
items.description: Printed paper publications that report on current events.

guidance.disposal: Paper recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Remove any plastic sleeves before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Nylon Bags
items.description: Flexible plastic bags often used for carrying groceries or other items.

guidance.disposal: Plastic recycling or reuse
guidance.preparation: Avoid throwing away bags that can be reused. Check local recycling rules.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Oil Filters
items.description: Devices used in vehicles to remove impurities from engine oil. They are made of metal and paper.

guidance.disposal: Dispose at a hazardous waste facility or return to an auto shop that recycles used oil and filters.
guidance.preparation: Drain the filter to remove oil before disposal. Dispose of used oil and filters at a hazardous waste facility.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Office Supplies
items.description: Items like pens, paper, staplers, or folders used in workspaces.

guidance.disposal: Paper items can be recycled, while plastic and metal items may need to be sorted depending on local recycling rules.
guidance.preparation: Sort and recycle according to material type (e.g., paper, plastic, metal). Avoid throwing away hazardous items like markers with ink.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Paint
items.description: A liquid or mastic composition used for decorative or protective coatings, typically for walls or surfaces.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site, or allow to dry completely and dispose of in regular trash if small amounts
guidance.preparation: Do not pour liquid paint down the drain. Handle oil-based paints with extra caution.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Petrol
items.description: A volatile flammable liquid used as fuel for internal combustion engines.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Store in a safe container away from heat or flame. Do not dispose of in drains or regular trash.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Palm Kernel Shells
items.description: The hard outer covering of palm seeds left over from oil extraction. They are often used as fuel for bioenergy or as mulch in agriculture.

guidance.disposal: Compost or use for biofuel if available.
guidance.preparation: Compost or use as biofuel. Avoid dumping in public spaces to prevent pollution.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Plastic Chairs
items.description: Lightweight seating made from molded plastic, commonly used in homes and public spaces.

guidance.disposal: Recycle through plastic recycling programs if accepted. Otherwise, dispose of in bulk waste.
guidance.preparation: Do not burn. Recycle at plastic recycling centers or dispose of in bulk waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Plastic Utensils
items.description: Disposable cutlery made from plastic, often used in take-out food services. They are usually single-use.

guidance.disposal: Single-use plastic utensils should be thrown in the trash unless local recycling programs accept them.
guidance.preparation: Check if your local recycling accepts plastic utensils. Wash them before recycling to prevent contamination.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Pizza Boxes
items.description: Cardboard boxes typically used to store and deliver pizza.

guidance.disposal: Recycling bin if clean, or regular trash if soiled with grease
guidance.preparation: Only recycle the non-greasy parts of the box.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Pesticides
items.description: Chemicals used to eliminate pests or unwanted plants.

guidance.disposal: Hazardous waste collection site
guidance.preparation: Store securely and follow label instructions. Do not pour down drains.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Radios
items.description: Electronic devices used to receive radio broadcasts.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove batteries before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Rag
items.description: Pieces of old fabric or cloth often used for cleaning or other purposes.

guidance.disposal: Textile recycling or regular trash
guidance.preparation: Wash or dry clean if donating. Reuse whenever possible.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Razor Blade
items.description: Sharp metal blades used for shaving or cutting.

guidance.disposal: Wrap securely and dispose of in regular trash or sharps disposal if applicable
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid cuts. Use a blade disposal container if possible.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Receipts
items.description: Paper records of transactions, often printed on thermal paper.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash or paper recycling if local guidelines allow
guidance.preparation: Thermal paper may contain chemicals that make it unsuitable for composting.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Rubber Bands
items.description: Elastic loops made from rubber used to hold objects together.

guidance.disposal: Re-use whenever possible or dispose of them in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Reuse if possible. Avoid littering as they can harm wildlife. Dispose of them in a waste bin.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Rubber Slippers
items.description: Footwear made from rubber, commonly used in tropical climates.

guidance.disposal: Reuse if possible, or dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Reuse or recycle where possible. Avoid burning, as rubber emits harmful chemicals.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Rusty Metal
items.description: Metal items that have corroded due to oxidation.

guidance.disposal: Take to a scrap metal recycler.
guidance.preparation: Wear gloves to avoid cuts or tetanus infection. Recycle at a metal facility.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Rubble
items.description: Waste material from construction or demolition, including bricks, concrete, and other debris.

guidance.disposal: Construction waste disposal sites or reuse as fill material
guidance.preparation: Handle heavy materials carefully to avoid injury.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Shampoo Bottles
items.description: Plastic containers used to store liquid shampoo or conditioner.

guidance.disposal: Plastic recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Rinse bottles before recycling. Remove caps if required by local recycling rules.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Solar Panels
items.description: Panels used to convert sunlight into electricity, often found in renewable energy installations.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling or specialized solar panel recycling programs
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid damaging the panels or exposure to hazardous materials.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Shoes
items.description: Wearable items designed to protect the feet.

guidance.disposal: Donate if in good condition, otherwise dispose of in regular trash or specialized shoe recycling programs
guidance.preparation: Ensure shoes are clean if donating. Some stores offer recycling programs.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sachet Water
items.description: Small plastic sachets used to package drinking water, commonly found in Nigeria.

guidance.disposal: Recycle if local facilities accept plastic film, or throw in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Avoid littering. Ensure plastic is sent for recycling if accepted locally.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Scrap Metal
items.description: Discarded metal items that can be recycled to produce new metal products. This includes aluminum, steel, and other valuable metals.

guidance.disposal: Take to a scrap metal recycler.
guidance.preparation: Store safely to avoid injury. Recycle at metal collection points.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sponges
items.description: Porous cleaning tools made from synthetic or natural materials. They are usually not recyclable but can be reused until worn out.

guidance.disposal: Throw away in regular trash unless they are made from biodegradable materials.
guidance.preparation: Do not flush down the drain. Dispose of used sponges in regular trash or compost if biodegradable.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Styrofoam
items.description: Lightweight, foam-like material often used for packaging or food containers.

guidance.disposal: Specialized recycling centers or regular trash (if not recyclable locally)
guidance.preparation: Check local recycling guidelines as styrofoam is not accepted everywhere.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sellotape
items.description: Clear or transparent adhesive tape used for packaging or wrapping.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash
guidance.preparation: Avoid placing in recycling bins as it can contaminate paper recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sticky Notes
items.description: Small pieces of paper with a re-adherable strip of adhesive on the back.

guidance.disposal: Paper recycling bin or compost if clean
guidance.preparation: Remove any non-paper materials like plastic holders or clips before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sweet Wrapper
items.description: Small wrappers used to cover sweets or candy, often made of plastic or foil.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash or recycling if locally accepted
guidance.preparation: Check if the wrapper is recyclable; many candy wrappers contain mixed materials.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Syringe
items.description: Medical devices used to inject fluids into or withdraw fluids from the body.

guidance.disposal: Sharps disposal container or hazardous waste collection
guidance.preparation: Do not dispose of in regular trash. Handle with extreme care to avoid needle stick injuries.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Sand
items.description: Granular material composed of finely divided rock and mineral particles, often used in construction or landscaping.

guidance.disposal: Reuse or dispose of at construction waste facilities
guidance.preparation: Ensure the sand is free from contaminants if reusing.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Soil
items.description: A natural material composed of minerals, organic matter, and living organisms, often used for gardening.

guidance.disposal: Reuse for landscaping or dispose of at garden waste facilities
guidance.preparation: Ensure soil is uncontaminated before reuse.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Television
items.description: Electronic devices used to display video content, available in various formats such as LCD, plasma, or CRT.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove batteries from remotes. Do not throw televisions into regular trash as they may contain hazardous materials.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Textiles
items.description: Material made of natural or synthetic fibers, often used for clothing, curtains, and upholstery.

guidance.disposal: Donate, recycle at textile recycling centers, or dispose of in regular trash if damaged
guidance.preparation: Wash and clean textiles if donating or recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Toothpaste Tubes
items.description: Plastic or aluminum tubes used to store toothpaste.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable in most places. Throw in regular trash unless special recycling programs are available.
guidance.preparation: Ensure fully used before disposal. Some tubes (with aluminum or foil) are not recyclable.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Tea Bags
items.description: Small porous bags used to infuse tea leaves or herbs in hot water.

guidance.disposal: Compost if biodegradable, or dispose of in regular trash if synthetic
guidance.preparation: Check if the bag is made of plastic or biodegradable materials before composting.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Tiles
items.description: Flat, often square or rectangular pieces used to cover floors, walls, or surfaces, often made from ceramic or stone.

guidance.disposal: Construction waste disposal site
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid breaking and causing injury.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Tissue
items.description: Soft, disposable paper products often used for hygiene purposes.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash (if used) or compost (if clean and uncoated)
guidance.preparation: Do not flush tissues down the toilet as they can cause blockages.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Torch Light
items.description: A portable handheld device that emits light using a battery or rechargeable power source.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove batteries before disposal and recycle separately.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Toner Cartridges
items.description: Cartridges containing toner powder used in laser printers and photocopiers.

guidance.disposal: Return to manufacturer for recycling or drop off at e-waste collection points
guidance.preparation: Handle with care to avoid spilling toner powder.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Trees
items.description: Parts of trees including branches and trunks, typically resulting from landscaping or storm damage.

guidance.disposal: Garden waste facility or composting
guidance.preparation: Large trees may require cutting before disposal. Some regions may offer curbside pickup for yard waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Tires
items.description: Rubber coverings that fit around wheels to provide traction for vehicles.

guidance.disposal: Tyre recycling facility, or return to tyre dealers
guidance.preparation: Tyres are often not accepted in regular waste disposal systems due to their bulky nature.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Umbrellas
items.description: Handheld devices designed to protect users from rain or sunlight, typically made of fabric and metal.

guidance.disposal: Regular trash if broken, or recycle parts if possible
guidance.preparation: Remove any metal parts if separating for recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Used Batteries
items.description: Devices that store energy for powering electronics, typically made of metals and chemicals.

guidance.disposal: Take to a hazardous waste collection facility or return to stores with battery recycling programs.
guidance.preparation: Store in a cool, dry place to avoid leaks. Dispose of at hazardous waste collection points or recycling facilities.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Used Generator Parts
items.description: Old or broken parts from generators, typically made of metal and plastic.

guidance.disposal: Recycle at scrap metal facilities or e-waste centers if they contain electrical components.
guidance.preparation: Dispose of at a scrap metal facility. If they contain electrical components, treat them as e-waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Washing Machines
items.description: Large household appliances used for washing clothes and textiles.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center, or return to retailer if they offer disposal services
guidance.preparation: Disconnect from electrical outlets and water lines before disposal.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Watch
items.description: Small wearable devices used to tell time, often made of metal, plastic, or leather.

guidance.disposal: E-waste recycling center
guidance.preparation: Remove batteries before disposal, and recycle separately.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Water Bottle
items.description: Containers used to store and transport water, often made from plastic, metal, or glass.

guidance.disposal: Recycle if plastic or dispose of in regular trash if damaged
guidance.preparation: Rinse bottles before recycling, and ensure that they are empty.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Whiteboard
items.description: Smooth, hard surfaces designed for non-permanent markings with dry-erase markers.

guidance.disposal: Bulk trash or specialized recycling centers
guidance.preparation: Remove and recycle accessories such as markers separately.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Wallpaper
items.description: Decorative paper or vinyl used to cover walls.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable, dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Avoid burning (especially vinyl wallpaper) as it can release toxic fumes. Dispose of in regular waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Wood Shavings
items.description: Small pieces of wood left over from woodworking. They are often used for animal bedding, mulch, or compost.

guidance.disposal: Compostable in organic waste bins or use for mulch in gardens.
guidance.preparation: Avoid mixing with chemicals or treated wood. Compost or dispose of in organic waste.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Worn-out Fabrics
items.description: Old or damaged textiles from clothing or household items.

guidance.disposal: Donate if in good condition, or recycle through textile recycling programs.
guidance.preparation: Donate usable items. If disposing, ensure they are clean to avoid attracting pests and insects.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.legacyCategory: Organic Waste (if natural materials) / Inorganic Waste (if synthetic)

items.name: Woven Baskets
items.description: Handcrafted containers made from natural materials like bamboo, palm fronds, or reeds. They are biodegradable and can be reused or composted.

guidance.disposal: If made of natural materials, compost or dispose of as organic waste.
guidance.preparation: If biodegradable, compost. If synthetic, ensure proper disposal in regular trash.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.legacyCategory: Organic Waste (if natural materials) / Inorganic Waste (if synthetic)

items.name: Wrapping Sheet
items.description: Paper used to wrap gifts, often brightly colored or patterned.

guidance.disposal: Recycle if plain paper, or dispose of in regular trash if metallic or plastic-coated
guidance.preparation: Remove any non-paper elements such as tape, ribbons, and bows before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: X-ray Film
items.description: A special type of plastic film used in medical imaging.

guidance.disposal: Return to medical facilities or take to special recycling centers that extract silver.
guidance.preparation: Handle carefully as it contains silver. Return to specialized recycling programs to prevent pollution.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Yoghurt Container
items.description: Plastic containers used to store yoghurt or similar dairy products.

guidance.disposal: Plastic recycling bin
guidance.preparation: Rinse the container before recycling to remove food residue.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Yam Peels
items.description: The outer skin of yams, removed during food preparation.

guidance.disposal: Compost or dispose of with organic waste.
guidance.preparation: Compost where possible. Avoid littering as they can attract pests.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Yarn
items.description: A long, continuous thread used for knitting or weaving. Made from natural or synthetic fibers.

guidance.disposal: Donate or recycle through textile recycling programs. Compost natural fibers like wool or cotton.
guidance.preparation: If natural fibers, it can be composted. Otherwise, dispose of in regular waste. Avoid burning, especially synthetic fibers.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.legacyCategory: Organic Waste (if natural fibers) / Inorganic Waste (if synthetic fibers)

items.name: Zinc Roofing Sheets
items.description: Metal sheets used for roofing, commonly found in Nigeria.

guidance.disposal: Recycle as scrap metal.
guidance.preparation: Wear gloves when handling to avoid cuts. Recycle at a metal facility.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Zobo Leaves
items.description: Dried hibiscus leaves used to make Zobo which is a popular Nigerian drink.

guidance.disposal: Compost or dispose of with organic waste.
guidance.preparation: Compost to reduce organic waste. Ensure they are not mixed with plastic or other contaminants.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Zip Ties
items.description: Small plastic ties used for securing objects. They are single-use.

guidance.disposal: Non-recyclable plastic. Dispose of in regular trash.
guidance.preparation: Cut them into smaller pieces before disposal to prevent wildlife entanglement. Do not flush.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Cardboard
items.description: Thick, sturdy paper material often used for packaging and shipping.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or curbside recycling
guidance.preparation: Remove any non-paper elements like plastic or foam before recycling. Flatten boxes to save space.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Glass
items.description: Hard, brittle material commonly used for bottles and containers.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or curbside recycling
guidance.preparation: Rinse glass items and remove any lids or caps. Do not recycle broken glass with regular recyclables.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Metal
items.description: Solid material commonly used for construction, packaging, and manufacturing.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or metal scrap yard
guidance.preparation: Remove any non-metal parts, like plastic or rubber, before recycling.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Organic
items.description: Biodegradable material that comes from living organisms, such as food scraps or plant trimmings.

guidance.disposal: Compost bin or organic waste collection service
guidance.preparation: Avoid adding meat, dairy, or oils to the compost. Keep compostable materials dry.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Paper
items.description: Thin sheets of material made from wood pulp, used for writing, printing, and packaging.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or curbside recycling
guidance.preparation: Avoid recycling wet or soiled paper. Remove any staples or clips.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Plastic
items.description: Synthetic or semi-synthetic material used in a wide range of products.

guidance.disposal: Recycling center or curbside recycling
guidance.preparation: Rinse plastic items and check recycling symbols to ensure they are accepted. Remove labels and lids if required.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT

items.name: Trash
items.description: Waste that cannot be recycled or composted, including items contaminated by food or hazardous materials.

guidance.disposal: General trash bin or landfill
guidance.preparation: Separate recyclables and compostables before disposing of general trash. Avoid mixing hazardous waste with trash.
guidance.jurisdiction: General guidance; confirm for the FCT
